pubbanna.cp: neut. a name given to 7 kinds of cereals such as rice, wheat.

pubbanta.p: [ pubba + anta ] (pu,na) Google Translate (1) The old - the old - for the edge. (2) The present benefit for the past. (The machine of life. Suffering.) (3) Being the origin of natural dharma. (4) For the east. (5) For the past life. (Ti) (6) The one who has the pure meaning of ancient times.
